$comment: How the checker reads a Gorgias view export. Edit this file, then run `npm run rules` so the page and the CLI pick it up. Header names come from a Gorgias trial account (Nov 2, 2026). The AI Agent tags, the AI Agent Outcome values and the tag separator were checked on a Gorgias trial with AI Agent traffic on Nov 22, 2026. Categories are still keyword estimates.

aiOutcomeField.note: Gorgias-managed. Values: Handover::With message, Handover::Without message, Close::With message, Close::Without message, Snooze::With message.

aiIntent.note: Filled automatically by Gorgias, three levels (e.g. Order::Cancel::Other). The first two levels decide the category when they are in categories.json `intents`.

resolution.note: The action taken, when the brand lets AI Agent autofill it (e.g. Order::Cancelled, Information Given). Shown as context only; it doesn't change the outcome.

customerMessages.note: Read, but not used to infer that a customer came back.

contactReason.note: Account-specific dropdown; used as extra text for categories.

firstMessage.note: A view export has no message text. Left empty until a real export with a first-message column is seen.

tagSeparatorNote: Confirmed Nov 22, 2026: commas, no spaces, quoted cell.

notes.ai_close: AI Agent resolved the ticket on its own. Gorgias removes it if the ticket reopens, so the final tags show only the last state.
notes.ai_handover: AI Agent handed the ticket to the team. Wins over ai_close: a handover means a human got the ticket.
notes.ai_snooze: AI Agent snoozed the ticket waiting for the customer. Snoozed tickets are exported with a Closed date; only this tag shows they're waiting.
notes.ai_processing: AI Agent is working on the ticket. Removed when it reaches an outcome.
notes.ai_answered: Added on every AI reply, whatever the outcome. Never an outcome by itself.
notes.ai_ignore: AI Agent skipped the ticket (a rule told it not to answer). Not counted as AI-handled.
notes.ai_executed_action: AI Agent completed an action in Shopify. Seen Nov 22, 2026 on an order cancel that went through in Shopify.
notes.ai_failed_action: AI Agent started an action that couldn't complete, for example the order had already shipped. From the Gorgias docs; not seen in an export yet.

outcomeField.note: Used only when a ticket has no AI tag. Gorgias allows five values: Handover::With message, Handover::Without message, Close::With message, Close::Without message, Snooze::With message. 'With message' is about the whole ticket. Matched on the prefix, lowercase.

resolution.note: Ticket Field: Resolution values. Action values mean an action was recorded; information values mean the ticket was only answered. Anything else counts as other. Context only: it doesn't change the outcome.
